popover.accessibility-content: This popover has role="region" and aria-haspopup="true".
popover.accessibility-detail: Focus is restored to the trigger when closed (restoreFocus is enabled by default).
popover.accessibility-note: Configure ARIA attributes for screen reader support.

ai.prompt: I'm looking at the Solaris UI documentation for {{component}} ({{url}}). Help me understand how to use it. Be ready to explain concepts, give examples, or help debug based on it.

popover.alignments-note: Control alignment relative to the trigger with start, center, and end.
popover.appearance-note: Surface has subtle styling. Outline has a visible border with surface background.
popover.basic-content: This is the popover content area.
popover.basic-note: Click the button to open the popover. Click outside or press Escape to close.
popover.close-behavior-note: Close on outside click and Escape key are enabled by default.
popover.description: Non-modal floating content foundation connected to a trigger element. Supports structured content, interactive elements, and programmatic control.
popover.escape-content: Press Escape to close this popover.

examples.note: Start with the default zero-spacing popover, then explore placements and variants below.

installation.note: Install the single Solaris package, then import the directives.

popover.interactive-note: Popover can contain buttons, links, and form fields.
popover.match-width-content: This panel has the same width as the trigger button.
popover.match-width-note: The panel width matches the trigger element width, useful for Select-like components.
popover.max-height-content: This panel caps at 240px and scrolls internally instead of overflowing the viewport.
popover.max-width-content: This panel has a maximum width of 200px. Long content will wrap.
popover.min-width-content: This panel has a minimum width of 300px.
popover.outline-content: Outline appearance with visible border and surface background.
popover.outside-click-content: Click outside this popover to close it.
popover.padding-note: Control inner padding of the popover panel.

padding-zero.note: Popover is a zero-spacing container by default: it renders chrome only. Use padding="md" for simple text, padding="none" for structured content like lists and menus.

popover.placements-note: Popover can appear on any side of the trigger element.

props.note: Props table coming soon with the table component.

popover.radius-note: Control the border radius of the popover panel.
popover.reactive-content: This popover repositions automatically when you scroll.
popover.reactive-note: Popover uses CDK FlexibleConnectedPositionStrategy to reactively reposition on scroll and resize.
popover.scroll-hint: Scroll inside this container while the popover is open to see reactive repositioning.
popover.title: Popover
popover.width-constraints-note: Control minimum and maximum panel width.
